description: This file defines a React functional component for the user profile page. It manages personal details such as name, age, gender, height, weight, and activity level, including loading current data, form state handling, submission, and user feedback.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads user profile data from the API and populates the form state.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles form input changes, updating the form state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, sending updated profile data to the API and providing user feedback.
